description: This file defines the 'GrainAddress' class, which represents an address for a grain in Orleans, including its identifiers, silo address, and membership version. It provides methods for equality comparison, string representation, and address creation.

classes.name: GrainAddress
classes.description: Represents an address in Orleans, including grain ID, activation ID, silo address, and membership version, with methods for equality, matching, and string formatting.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if this GrainAddress is equal to another object or GrainAddress.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Determines if this GrainAddress matches another, considering silo address, grain ID, and activation ID.

methods.name: MatchesGrainIdAndSilo
methods.description: Static method to check if two GrainAddresses have matching grain IDs and silo addresses.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on silo address, grain ID, and activation ID.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the GrainAddress.

methods.name: ToFullString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string including membership version.

methods.name: NewActivationAddress
methods.description: Creates a new GrainAddress for a specific silo, grain, and activation ID.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Creates a GrainAddress with specified silo, grain, and activation ID.
